title: Physical extraction follows demonstrated independent purpose
question: Must every optional module become a separate Composer package before 1.0?
context: Architecture decision recorded by the agent under the owner's explicit design delegation. Phase tasks and implementation remain deferred.
decision: Complete logical separation and qualify relocation safety before 1.0. Keep AzGuard-only modules internal. Open a separate future extraction plan only for an independently useful integration/adapter, retaining FQCNs, public/machine identities, migration history and populated data with one autoload owner.
rationale: Logical ownership and optional activation deliver a smaller runtime without package multiplication. Composer PSR-4 can change archive ownership later; that movement must not create an API, schema or data migration. Separate licensing belongs to a self-contained integration and cannot split authorization semantics.

evidence.note: The owner delegated architecture choices and required an affirmative target design.
